methodology.unit: team-game points = sum of a team's players' pts within one game_id
methodology.game_filter: only game_ids with exactly 2 distinct teams
methodology.mean_total: mean(row_pts + col_pts) over the pairing's meetings (symmetric)
methodology.mean_margin: mean(row_pts - col_pts) over the pairing's meetings (anti-symmetric; pools home+away, NOT a home-court split)
not_this: NOT a prediction of any future matchup (describes games already played)
NOT a home/away split (per-player table carries no venue flag)
NOT opponent-adjusted / strength-of-schedule (raw pooled means only)
